//: Build profiles for EAS, Expo's cloud build service.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: `expo start` runs a development server on your
computer and the QR code points at it. Close the terminal and the app
stops working. These profiles produce real installable apps that keep
THE ANDROID ONE IS THE USEFUL ONE TODAY. `preview` builds an APK you can
download and install directly -- no Play Store, no account, no cost. It
bundles `extra.apiUrl` from app.json, so it talks to the deployed server
THE iOS ONE NEEDS AN APPLE DEVELOPER ACCOUNT ($99/year). Apple does not
permit installing an app on an iPhone without one. That is their rule and
Builds run on Expo's machines, which is why iOS is possible at all from
Windows -- the compile happens on their Mac, not yours.

development.//: A dev client: like Expo Go but with this project's own native modules. Only needed if a dependency stops working in Expo Go.

preview.//: THE ONE TO USE. Android produces an .apk you can install by tapping it. iOS produces a build for TestFlight, which requires the Apple account.

production.//: Store submission. Android builds an .aab, which is what Google Play requires and which you cannot install directly.
